name: Shake text
summary: Letters that jitter and tremble, for angry, scared or shocked words. Deterministic jitter, so every render matches.

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame; overrides at when set

params.name: size
params.note: font size; shrinks to fit 980 px

params.name: intensity
params.note: jitter distance in px at size 130

params.name: seed
params.note: change to get a different tremble

author: krakujs
